mcp__codex_apps__h_process_checkpoint
declarations.description:
Same-boot single-process Linux CRIU snapshots, only on administrator-pinned operator hosts. Inspect returns exact identity and resource limits. Dump stops/exits the original only after a validated private snapshot. Restore returns restored_stopped, never claims the program is running. A separate resume requires exact restored identity and acknowledge_resume. Old requests never silently relaunch; status exposes uncertain states. Internal pipes/unchanged files only; external sockets/terminals/GPU/multi-process state not supported. Uses existing sudo authority; no images or secrets returned. This tool is part of plugin `h`.

MCP server instructions: Filesystem tools. File lines render as `N:hh|content`; `N:hh` is the line id edit tools target, and edit results are diffs with fresh ids, so edits chain without re-viewing files. Reuse returned content and ids; read complete relevant blocks, then act on them. Each response costs a round trip: first decide what you need next, then request every call that doesn't depend on another's result in that one response.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__codex_apps__h_process_checkpoint(args: { acknowledge_process_stop?: boolean; acknowledge_resume?: boolean; action: "inspect" | "dump" | "restore" | "status" | "resume"; checkpoint_id?: string; expected_identity?: { boot_id: string; pid: number; start_ticks: number; uid: number; }; host: string; pid?: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```
